rules.quote: Keep bash libs for other consumers
rules.rule: Keep the bash libraries in place for other consumers instead of removing them.

rules.quote: When this is scheduled, use parallel agents for the two stage scripts.
rules.rule: When the conversion is scheduled, use parallel agents for the two stage scripts.

rules.quote: Create shared lib first as foundation.
rules.rule: Create the shared library first, as the foundation, before the other conversion work.

rules.quote: When embedding-related code needs a dimension, model name, or provider — import from `agentdb` config
rules.rule: When embedding-related code needs a dimension, model name, or provider, import it from the `agentdb` config module.

rules.quote: never hardcode
rules.rule: Never hardcode embedding dimension, model name, or provider values in code.

rules.quote: before next sync, check if more patches have been absorbed.
rules.rule: Before performing the next upstream sync, check whether more of our patches have been absorbed upstream.

rules.quote: NEVER start verdaccio manually
rules.rule: Never start Verdaccio manually; Verdaccio is managed by systemd.

rules.quote: Use dummy `_auth`:
rules.rule: When configuring npm auth for local Verdaccio, use a dummy `_auth` value in `.npmrc`.

rules.quote: Pipeline scripts should use `--registry http://localhost:4873` explicitly.
rules.rule: In pipeline scripts, specify the local Verdaccio registry explicitly with `--registry http://localhost:4873`.

rules.quote: Do what has been asked; nothing more, nothing less
rules.rule: Do exactly what the user asked and nothing beyond it (no extra work or scope).

rules.quote: NEVER create files unless they're absolutely necessary for achieving your goal
rules.rule: Never create a new file unless it is absolutely necessary to achieve the goal.

rules.quote: ALWAYS prefer editing an existing file to creating a new one
rules.rule: Prefer editing an existing file over creating a new one.

rules.quote: NEVER proactively create documentation files (*.md) or README files unless explicitly requested
rules.rule: Never proactively create documentation (.md) or README files unless the user explicitly requests them.

rules.quote: NEVER save working files, text/mds, or tests to the root folder
rules.rule: Never save working files, text files, markdown files, or tests to the root folder.

rules.quote: Never continuously check status after spawning a swarm — wait for results
rules.rule: After spawning a swarm, do not continuously check status; wait for the results.

rules.quote: NEVER begin execution — spawning agents/swarms, running a migration, or making multi-file changes — without an explicit user go-ahead
rules.rule: Never begin execution (spawning agents or swarms, running a migration, or making multi-file changes) without an explicit user go-ahead.

rules.quote: If you asked for a green light and the reply is anything other than a clear yes, you are still planning — re-confirm before acting
rules.rule: If you asked for a green light and the user's reply is anything other than a clear yes, keep planning and re-confirm before acting.

rules.quote: ALWAYS read a file before editing it
rules.rule: Always read a file before editing it.

rules.quote: NEVER commit secrets, credentials, or .env files
rules.rule: Never commit secrets, credentials, or .env files.

rules.quote: NEVER save to root folder — use the directories below
rules.rule: Never save files to the root folder; use the designated directories instead.

rules.quote: Use `/src` for source code files
rules.rule: Place source code files in `/src`.

rules.quote: Use `/tests` for test files
rules.rule: Place test files in `/tests`.

rules.quote: Use `/docs` for documentation and markdown files
rules.rule: Place documentation and markdown files in `/docs`.

rules.quote: Use `/config` for configuration files
rules.rule: Place configuration files in `/config`.

rules.quote: Use `/scripts` for utility scripts
rules.rule: Place utility scripts in `/scripts`.

rules.quote: Use `/examples` for example code
rules.rule: Place example code in `/examples`.

rules.quote: Follow Domain-Driven Design with bounded contexts
rules.rule: Architect the project following Domain-Driven Design with bounded contexts.

rules.quote: Keep files under 500 lines
rules.rule: Keep every file under 500 lines.

rules.quote: Use typed interfaces for all public APIs
rules.rule: Define typed interfaces for all public APIs.

rules.quote: Prefer TDD London School (mock-first) for new code
rules.rule: Prefer TDD London School (mock-first) testing for new code.

rules.quote: Use event sourcing for state changes
rules.rule: Implement state changes using event sourcing.

rules.quote: Ensure input validation at system boundaries
rules.rule: Ensure input validation occurs at system boundaries.

rules.quote: ALWAYS run tests after making code changes
rules.rule: Always run tests after making code changes.

rules.quote: ALWAYS verify build succeeds before committing
rules.rule: Always verify the build succeeds before committing.

rules.quote: Never narrow it to loopback
rules.rule: Never narrow the Verdaccio bind from `*:4873` to loopback only.

rules.quote: never suggest starting or stopping Verdaccio (it is always on)
rules.rule: Never suggest starting or stopping the Verdaccio instance, which is always running.

rules.quote: Diagnose with `lsof -nP -iTCP:4873 -sTCP:LISTEN`
rules.rule: If `localhost:4873` hangs while the LAN or Tailscale IP responds 200 on `/-/ping`, diagnose the shadowing second listener with `lsof -nP -iTCP:4873 -sTCP:LISTEN`.

rules.quote: Fix: stop the forward in VS Code's Ports panel
rules.rule: When a VS Code Remote auto-forward is shadowing `127.0.0.1:4873`, fix it by stopping that forward in VS Code's Ports panel.

rules.quote: Create or update tests first
rules.rule: In feature work, create or update tests before implementing the change.

rules.quote: Run tests — verify pass
rules.rule: After implementing a feature change, run the tests and verify they pass.

rules.quote: Run build — verify success
rules.rule: After tests pass, run the build and verify it succeeds.

rules.quote: NEVER hardcode API keys, secrets, or credentials in source files
rules.rule: Never hardcode API keys, secrets, or credentials in source files.

rules.quote: NEVER commit .env files or any file containing secrets
rules.rule: Never commit .env files or any file containing secrets.

rules.quote: Always validate user input at system boundaries
rules.rule: Always validate user input at system boundaries.

rules.quote: Always sanitize file paths to prevent directory traversal
rules.rule: Always sanitize file paths to prevent directory traversal.

rules.quote: Run `ruflo security scan` after security-related changes
rules.rule: Run `ruflo security scan` after making security-related changes.

rules.quote: Batch ALL independent operations into a single message
rules.rule: Batch all independent operations into a single message.

rules.quote: Spawn ALL agents in ONE message using the Agent tool with `run_in_background: true`
rules.rule: Spawn all agents in one message using the Agent tool with `run_in_background: true`.

rules.quote: Batch ALL independent file reads/writes/edits in ONE message
rules.rule: Batch all independent file reads, writes, and edits into one message.

rules.quote: Batch ALL independent Bash commands in ONE message
rules.rule: Batch all independent Bash commands into one message.

rules.quote: Single file edit or fix: work directly, no agents needed
rules.rule: For a single file edit or fix, work directly without spawning agents.

rules.quote: 3+ files, new feature, or cross-module refactoring: spawn agents
rules.rule: For work touching 3+ files, a new feature, or cross-module refactoring, spawn agents.

rules.quote: When in doubt, start direct — escalate to agents if scope grows
rules.rule: When in doubt about task complexity, start working directly and escalate to agents only if the scope grows.

rules.quote: Use `hive-mind_spawn` (or `ruflo hive-mind spawn --claude`) when convening a council: named experts, per-question voting, Byzantine consensus, queen synthesis.
rules.rule: Use `hive-mind_spawn` (or `ruflo hive-mind spawn --claude`) when convening a council with named experts, per-question voting, Byzantine consensus, and queen synthesis.

rules.quote: DO NOT call `swarm_init` reflexively at task start (ADR-0098 — applies to flat-coordination swarms only).
rules.rule: Do not call `swarm_init` reflexively at task start (applies to flat-coordination swarms only).

rules.quote: After spawning agents: STOP and wait for results.
rules.rule: After spawning agents, stop and wait for the results.

rules.quote: Do not poll.
rules.rule: Do not poll agent status after spawning agents.

rules.quote: When you need a capability, choose in this order. Stop at the first match.
rules.rule: When you need a capability, choose tools in the listed order and stop at the first match.

rules.quote: Sub-agents spawned via `Agent` typically inherit the parent's `mcp__ruflo__*` toolset.
rules.rule: Assume sub-agents spawned via the `Agent` tool inherit the parent's `mcp__ruflo__*` toolset.

rules.quote: For long-running sub-tasks where MCP visibility is uncertain, run a discovery probe before spawning rather than pre-fetching results.
rules.rule: For long-running sub-tasks where MCP visibility is uncertain, run a discovery probe before spawning instead of pre-fetching results.

rules.quote: Run `ruflo skill list` — a skill may already provide it
rules.rule: When the active toolset doesn't cover a needed capability, first run `ruflo skill list` to check whether a skill provides it.

rules.quote: Run `ruflo plugins list` — an installable plugin may provide it
rules.rule: If no skill covers the needed capability, run `ruflo plugins list` to check whether an installable plugin provides it.

rules.quote: Only after both come up empty, build the capability inline or ask the user
rules.rule: Only after both the skill list and plugin list come up empty, build the missing capability inline or ask the user.

rules.quote: NEVER install plugins without explicit user confirmation.
rules.rule: Never install a plugin without explicit user confirmation.

rules.quote: Install only when ALL hold:
rules.rule: Install a plugin only when the user asked for a capability not covered by `ruflo skill list` or active MCP tools AND the user confirmed the install.

rules.quote: NEVER `@ruflo` here — that is upstream's marketplace (ADR-0301)
rules.rule: Never install from the upstream `@ruflo` marketplace; use the `sparkleideas` marketplace for plugins.

rules.quote: never change plugin enable/disable at user scope
rules.rule: Never change plugin enable/disable state at user scope.

rules.quote: Tell user to run `/reload-plugins` if commands don't appear post-install.
rules.rule: If plugin commands don't appear after installation, tell the user to run `/reload-plugins`.

rules.quote: call ToolSearch to load a tool's schema before invoking it
rules.rule: Call ToolSearch to load a deferred `ruflo` MCP tool's schema before invoking it.

rules.quote: Do NOT call `mcp__ruflo__agentdb_session-start` or `mcp__ruflo__agentdb_session-end`
rules.rule: Do not call `mcp__ruflo__agentdb_session-start` or `mcp__ruflo__agentdb_session-end`; hooks manage session lifecycle automatically.

rules.quote: incorporate when relevant
rules.rule: When a before-task `[INTELLIGENCE] Relevant patterns...` hook signal appears, incorporate it if relevant.

rules.quote: consider the recommended agent type
rules.rule: When a during-task `[INFO] Routing task...` hook signal recommends an agent type, consider using it.

rules.quote: hooks store outcomes automatically; do not call session-start/end
rules.rule: Rely on hooks storing outcomes automatically after a task and do not call session-start/end yourself.

rules.quote: If `[INFO] Router not available` appears, proceed normally without routing.
rules.rule: If `[INFO] Router not available` appears, proceed normally without routing.

rules.quote: One-time bootstrap (user runs once, AI never): `claude mcp add claude-flow -- npx -y @sparkleideas/ruflo@latest`
rules.rule: Never run the one-time bootstrap `claude mcp add claude-flow -- npx -y @sparkleideas/ruflo@latest`; only the user runs it, once.
